reviews.title: Music will not play over HomePod
reviews.text: The FAQ answer regarding the issue of Airplay only playing voices contains the statement, "we have yet to find a solution for our audio engine without having to completely rebuild it." This is not an acceptable answer. A paid subscription service which uses music integration as one of its primary functions has an obligation to make sure it functions properly on the most common ways the app would be used. Apple Airplay to HomePods is a highly common listening tool. Lack of functionality through this medium is an application flaw. If such a flaw kept the voice segment of the audio from playing over bluetooth, the company would not rest until a solution was found. Refusing to do the necessary work to fix this issue unjustly penalizes Apple customers. Unless this issue gets addressed, I cannot recommend this app nor will I be renewing my subscription. In fact I’m contemplating asking for a refund since the app is not functioning as promised.
